# opnsense_firewall_geoip_settings (Data Source)

Reads the GeoIP database source configuration from the upstream system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_firewall_geoip_settings" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always set to `firewall_geoip_settings`.
- `url` (String) Download URL configured for the GeoIP country database.
